dataSource.zh-CN: 列表数据源；每一项通过 item 插槽渲染。
dataSource.en-US: Data source of the list; each entry is rendered through the item slot.

grid.zh-CN: 栅格配置：Row 的 align、gutter、justify、type 与 Col 的 span、offset、order、push、pull、响应式断点、class、style，class 与 style 落在每项外层的 Col 上。
grid.en-US: Grid configuration: align, gutter, justify and type of Row, and span, offset, order, push, pull, the responsive breakpoints, class and style of Col. class and style land on the Col around each item.

layout.zh-CN: 列表布局，可选 vertical 或 horizontal。

loading.zh-CN: 是否处于加载中，为 true 时显示 Spin。
loading.en-US: Whether the list is loading; a Spin is shown when true.

size.zh-CN: 列表尺寸，可选 small、default 或 large。
size.en-US: List size: small, default or large.

split.en-US: Whether to show dividers between items.

onClick.zh-CN: 列表项的点击回调，作用于每个没有自己 onClick 的项；有处理函数的项渲染为原生按钮。使用方写 @click，保留为函数 prop 是因为它的有无决定项是否渲染按钮。
onClick.en-US: Click handler for the items that have no onClick of their own; an item with a handler renders a native button. Callers write @click; it remains a function prop because its presence decides whether an item renders a button.

onRightClick.zh-CN: 列表项的右键（上下文菜单）回调，作用于每个没有自己 onRightClick 的项，这些项同样渲染为原生按钮。使用方写 @rightClick，保留为函数 prop 的原因同 onClick。
onRightClick.en-US: Context-menu handler for the items that have no onRightClick of their own; those items also render a native button. Callers write @rightClick; it remains a function prop for the same reason as onClick.

default.zh-CN: List.Item 子节点，渲染在 dataSource 各项之后。
default.en-US: List.Item children, rendered after the items of dataSource.

item.zh-CN: 渲染 dataSource 中的每一项，接收 item 与 index，返回一个或多个 List.Item。
item.en-US: Renders each entry of dataSource, receiving item and index and returning one or more List.Item.

emptyContent.zh-CN: 没有数据时的展示内容，缺省为语言包中的空文案。
emptyContent.en-US: Content shown when there is no data; the locale's empty text by default.

align.zh-CN: header 与 main 的垂直对齐方式，可选 flex-start、flex-end、center、baseline 或 stretch，未传时为 flex-start。
align.en-US: Vertical alignment of header and main: flex-start, flex-end, center, baseline or stretch; flex-start when omitted.

onClick.zh-CN: 点击回调，优先于 List 的 onClick；有处理函数时项渲染为原生按钮。使用方写 @click，保留为函数 prop 的原因同 List。
onClick.en-US: Click handler, taking precedence over the List's onClick; an item with a handler renders a native button. Callers write @click; it remains a function prop for the same reason as on List.

onRightClick.zh-CN: 右键（上下文菜单）回调，优先于 List 的 onRightClick；只设置它时项同样渲染为原生按钮。使用方写 @rightClick。
onRightClick.en-US: Context-menu handler, taking precedence over the List's onRightClick; an item with only this handler also renders a native button. Callers write @rightClick.

default.zh-CN: 列表项内容；可点击且没有 header 与 main 插槽时放在按钮内，否则放在按钮之外。
default.en-US: Item content; inside the button when the item is clickable and has no header or main slot, otherwise outside it.

extra.zh-CN: 列表项附加内容，渲染在按钮外，其中的交互元素可正常聚焦与点击，点击不会触发整行的点击。
extra.en-US: Additional item content, rendered outside the button; interactive elements in it stay focusable and clickable, and clicking them does not trigger the row's click.
